module: gameplayInterface module for special lights: reads and sets the taxi light state via the 'lights/taxiLights' controllers.
notes: Action 'setTaxiLightState'(state:string): calls setTaxiState(state) on all controllers of type lights/taxiLights.
Lookup 'taxiLightState'(): returns {result = getTaxiState()} of the first lights/taxiLights controller, or nil if there is none.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called at load: fills moduleActions and moduleLookups.

requestRegistration.desc: Registers the actions and lookups with gameplayInterface.
